title: Water Safety and Purification
content: To purify drinking water during an emergency, boiling is the safest method. Bring the water to a rolling boil for at least one minute (or three minutes at high altitudes). If boiling is not possible, use household bleach. Add 8 drops (about 1/8 teaspoon) of unscented liquid household bleach to 1 gallon of clear water. Mix well and wait 30 minutes before drinking. If the water is cloudy, filter it through a clean cloth first, and double the amount of bleach (16 drops). Alternatively, use commercial water purification tablets following the manufacturer's instructions.
